     3	/-!
     4	# Triangular update: statement and explicit constructions
     5	
     6	Source: `Sources/source.txt`, selected lemma `lemma:traingular_update`;
     7	original proof: `Sources/paper.tex`, lines 403–452.
     8	
     9	All vectors use zero-based `Fin k` indices. Thus the paper's coordinate i
    10	corresponds to Lean coordinate i-1. A trace contains the elementary relative
    11	errors of the specified sequential evaluation. `ErrorTrace.Valid` represents
    12	the standard rounding model when no overflow or underflow occurs; it does
    13	not postulate any bound on the accumulated error. Nonnegative unit roundoff
    14	is the contextual convention inherent in that model.
    15	
    16	Only the final theorem proof is left as scaffolding for the proving role.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	namespace Research.TriangularUpdate
    20	
    21	/-- The deterministic error constant from the source. -/
    22	noncomputable def gamma (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) : ℝ :=
    23	  (k : ℝ) * u / (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)
    24	
    25	/-- Relative errors of each multiplication, each possible accumulator addition,
    26	then the final subtraction and division. Addition at index zero is unused. -/
    27	structure ErrorTrace (k : ℕ) where
    28	  mulError : Fin (k - 1) → ℝ
    29	  addError : Fin (k - 1) → ℝ
    30	  subError : ℝ
    31	  divError : ℝ
    32	
    33	/-- Bounds only on errors of executed elementary operations. In particular,
    34	there is no rounded addition before the first product. -/
    35	def ErrorTrace.Valid {k : ℕ} (e : ErrorTrace k) (u : ℝ) : Prop :=
    36	  (∀ i, |e.mulError i| ≤ u) ∧
    37	  (∀ j, 0 < j.val → |e.addError j| ≤ u) ∧
    38	  |e.subError| ≤ u ∧ |e.divError| ≤ u
    39	
    40	/-- Embed one of the first k-1 coordinates into the full input vector. -/
    41	def prefixIndex {k : ℕ} (i : Fin (k - 1)) : Fin k :=
    42	  ⟨i.val, lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt (Nat.sub_le k 1)⟩
    43	
    44	/-- The paper's last coordinate k, using zero-based indexing. -/
    45	def lastIndex (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) : Fin k :=
    46	  ⟨k - 1, by omega⟩
    47	
    48	/-- Rounded individual product, tied to the original inputs. -/
    49	noncomputable def roundedProduct {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ)
    50	    (e : ErrorTrace k) (i : Fin (k - 1)) : ℝ :=
    51	  (a (prefixIndex i) * b (prefixIndex i)) * (1 + e.mulError i)
    52	
    53	/-- Sequential accumulator after n terms. The first term is its rounded
    54	product alone; each subsequent term incurs one addition error. Values beyond
    55	the input length are defined by keeping the completed accumulator. -/
    56	noncomputable def sequentialAccumulator {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ)
    57	    (e : ErrorTrace k) : ℕ → ℝ
    58	  | 0 => 0
    59	  | n + 1 =>
    60	      if h : n < k - 1 then
    61	        if n = 0 then roundedProduct a b e ⟨n, h⟩
    62	        else (sequentialAccumulator a b e n + roundedProduct a b e ⟨n, h⟩) *
    63	          (1 + e.addError ⟨n, h⟩)
    64	      else sequentialAccumulator a b e n
    65	
    66	/-- The computed inner product of the first k-1 entries. -/
    67	noncomputable def sequentialInnerProduct {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ)
    68	    (e : ErrorTrace k) : ℝ :=
    69	  sequentialAccumulator a b e (k - 1)
    70	
    71	/-- Rounded subtraction following the inner product. -/
    72	noncomputable def roundedNumerator {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ)
    73	    (c : ℝ) (e : ErrorTrace k) : ℝ :=
    74	  (c - sequentialInnerProduct a b e) * (1 + e.subError)
    75	
    76	/-- Actual result of the sequential inner product, subtraction, and division. -/
    77	noncomputable def computedUpdate {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (a b : Fin k → ℝ)
    78	    (c : ℝ) (e : ErrorTrace k) : ℝ :=
    79	  (roundedNumerator a b c e / b (lastIndex k hk)) * (1 + e.divError)
    80	
    81	/-- Coefficient of an inner-product term after all subsequent additions.
    82	The filter is the zero-based form of j = max(2,i),...,k-1 in the paper. -/
    83	noncomputable def innerCoefficient {k : ℕ} (e : ErrorTrace k)
    84	    (i : Fin (k - 1)) : ℝ :=
    85	  (1 + e.mulError i) *
    86	    ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (k - 1) => 0 < j.val ∧ i.val ≤ j.val)),
    87	      (1 + e.addError j)
    88	
    89	/-- The coefficient on the last input is the reciprocal of the two final
    90	rounding factors, as required by the backward equation. -/
    91	noncomputable def lastCoefficient {k : ℕ} (e : ErrorTrace k) : ℝ :=
    92	  ((1 + e.subError) * (1 + e.divError))⁻¹
    93	
    94	/-- One explicit perturbation vector on the original b. Zero input components
    95	receive zero perturbation; no division by an inner-product component occurs. -/
    96	noncomputable def perturbation {k : ℕ} (b : Fin k → ℝ)
    97	    (e : ErrorTrace k) (i : Fin k) : ℝ :=
    98	  if h : i.val < k - 1 then
    99	    b i * (innerCoefficient e ⟨i.val, h⟩ - 1)
   100	  else
   101	    b i * (lastCoefficient e - 1)

   103	/-- Elementary product bounds, proved from the individual rounding errors. -/
   104	lemma product_bounds {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)
   105	    (f : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
   106	    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, |f i - 1| ≤ u) (hn : (s.card : ℝ) * u < 1) :
   107	    1 - (s.card : ℝ) * u ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i ∧
   108	    (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ (1 - (s.card : ℝ) * u)⁻¹ := by
   109	  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
   110	  | empty => simp
   111	  | @insert x s hx ih =>
   112	    have hc : ((insert x s).card : ℝ) = (s.card : ℝ) + 1 := by
   113	      simp [Finset.card_insert_of_notMem hx]
   114	    have hs : (s.card : ℝ) * u < 1 := by rw [hc] at hn; nlinarith
   115	    have hfs : ∀ i ∈ s, |f i - 1| ≤ u := fun i hi => hf i (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hi)
   116	    obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ih hfs hs
   117	    have hfx0 := abs_le.mp (hf x (Finset.mem_insert_self x s))
   118	    have hfx : 1 - u ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 1 + u := by constructor <;> linarith
   119	    have hp : 0 < 1 - (s.card : ℝ) * u := by linarith
   120	    have hq : 0 < 1 - ((s.card : ℝ) + 1) * u := by rw [hc] at hn; linarith
   121	    have hsp : 0 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * u := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hu
   122	    rw [Finset.prod_insert hx, hc]
   123	    constructor
   124	    · have hm := mul_le_mul hl hfx.1 (by linarith : 0 ≤ 1 - u) (by linarith : 0 ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f i)
   125	      nlinarith
   126	    · have hm : f x * (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ (1 + u) * (1 - (s.card : ℝ) * u)⁻¹ :=
   127	        mul_le_mul hfx.2 hr (by linarith) (by positivity)
   128	      apply hm.trans
   129	      rw [inv_eq_one_div, inv_eq_one_div, mul_one_div]
   130	      apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hp hq).2
   131	      nlinarith [mul_nonneg hsp hu]

   133	lemma coefficient_bound {ι : Type*} [DecidableEq ι] (s : Finset ι)

   135	    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, |f i - 1| ≤ u) (hcard : s.card ≤ k)

   137	    |(∏ i ∈ s, f i) - 1| ≤ gamma k u := by

   139	    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by exact_mod_cast hcard) hu
   140	  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := product_bounds s f u hu hu1 hf (lt_of_le_of_lt hcount hk)
   141	  have hp : 0 < 1 - (k : ℝ) * u := by linarith

   146	    apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).2

   159	lemma innerCoefficient_bound {k : ℕ} (hk : 2 ≤ k) (e : ErrorTrace k)
   160	    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hku : (k : ℝ) * u < 1)

   179	  have hb := coefficient_bound Finset.univ f k u hu hu1 hf hc hku

   183	    (f : ι → ℝ) (k : ℕ) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1)
   184	    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, |f i - 1| ≤ u) (hcard : s.card ≤ k)

   193	  have hr' : (∏ i ∈ s, f i) ≤ (1 - (k : ℝ) * u)⁻¹ :=
   194	    hr.trans (inv_anti₀ hp (by linarith))
   195	  have hil : 1 - (k : ℝ) * u ≤ (∏ i ∈ s, f i)⁻¹ := by
   196	    simpa using inv_anti₀ hprod hr'

   199	    unfold gamma
   200	    apply (le_div_iff₀ hp).2

   203	    unfold gamma
   204	    field_simp

   209	    (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u) (hu1 : u < 1) (hku : (k : ℝ) * u < 1)
   210	    (he : e.Valid u) : |lastCoefficient e - 1| ≤ gamma k u := by
   211	  let f : Bool → ℝ := fun x => if x then 1 + e.subError else 1 + e.divError
   212	  have hf : ∀ x ∈ Finset.univ, |f x - 1| ≤ u := by
   213	    intro x hx
   214	    cases x <;> simp [f, he.2.2.1, he.2.2.2]

   218	noncomputable def suffixProduct {k : ℕ} (e : ErrorTrace k) (n : ℕ) : ℝ :=
   219	  ∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (k - 1) => 0 < j.val ∧ n ≤ j.val)),
   220	    (1 + e.addError j)

   222	lemma accumulator_expansion {k : ℕ} (a b : Fin k → ℝ) (e : ErrorTrace k)
   223	    (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≤ k - 1) :
   224	    (∑ i ∈ (Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin (k - 1) => i.val < n)),
   225	      a (prefixIndex i) * b (prefixIndex i) * innerCoefficient e i) =
   226	      sequentialAccumulator a b e n * suffixProduct e n := by
   227	  classical
   228	  induction n with
   229	  | zero => simp [sequentialAccumulator]
   230	  | succ n ih =>

   232	    let i : Fin (k - 1) := ⟨n, hnk⟩
   233	    have hs : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (k - 1) => j.val < n + 1)) =

   235	      ext j
   236	      simp [Fin.ext_iff, i]
   237	      omega
   238	    have hni : i ∉ (Finset.univ.filter (fun j : Fin (k - 1) => j.val < n)) := by
   239	      simp [i]
   240	    have hc : a (prefixIndex i) * b (prefixIndex i) * innerCoefficient e i =
   241	        roundedProduct a b e i * suffixProduct e n := by
   242	      simp only [innerCoefficient, roundedProduct, suffixProduct]
   243	      dsimp [i]
   244	      ring
   245	    rw [hs, Finset.sum_insert hni, ih (by omega), hc]
   246	    by_cases hz : n = 0

   248	      have heq : suffixProduct e 0 = suffixProduct e 1 := by
   249	        unfold suffixProduct
   250	        congr 1

   252	        simp
   253	        omega
   254	      simp only [sequentialAccumulator, dif_pos hnk, ↓reduceIte, zero_add, zero_mul,

   263	          0 < j.val ∧ n + 1 ≤ j.val)) := by simp [i]

   275	      ∑ i : Fin (k - 1), a (prefixIndex i) * b (prefixIndex i) * innerCoefficient e i := by

   280	        0 < j.val ∧ k - 1 ≤ j.val)) = ∅ := by
   281	      apply Finset.filter_eq_empty_iff.mpr
   282	      intro j hj
   283	      have := j.isLt
   284	      omega
   285	    rw [hf, Finset.prod_empty]

   292	/-- Full selected triangular-update lemma, for every legal elementary-error
   293	trace. The explicit perturbation simultaneously satisfies the exact backward
   294	equation and the source's componentwise gamma_k bound. -/
   295	theorem triangular_update
   296	    (k : ℕ) (hk : 2 ≤ k) (u : ℝ) (hu : 0 ≤ u)
   297	    (hku : (k : ℝ) * u < 1)
   298	    (a b : Fin k → ℝ) (c : ℝ)
   299	    (hb : b (lastIndex k hk) ≠ 0)
   300	    (e : ErrorTrace k) (he : e.Valid u) :
   301	    ((∑ i : Fin (k - 1),
   302	        a (prefixIndex i) *
   303	          (b (prefixIndex i) + perturbation b e (prefixIndex i))) +
   304	      computedUpdate hk a b c e *
   305	        (b (lastIndex k hk) + perturbation b e (lastIndex k hk)) = c) ∧
   306	    (∀ i : Fin k, |perturbation b e i| ≤ gamma k u * |b i|) := by
   307	  classical
   308	  have hk1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (k : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast (show 1 ≤ k by omega)
   309	  have hu1 : u < 1 := by nlinarith
   310	  have hsub : 0 < 1 + e.subError := by
   311	    have := (abs_le.mp he.2.2.1).1
   312	    linarith
   313	  have hdiv : 0 < 1 + e.divError := by
   314	    have := (abs_le.mp he.2.2.2).1
   315	    linarith
   316	  constructor
   317	  · have hp (i : Fin (k - 1)) :
   318	        b (prefixIndex i) + perturbation b e (prefixIndex i) =
   319	          b (prefixIndex i) * innerCoefficient e i := by
   320	      simp only [perturbation, prefixIndex, dif_pos i.isLt, Fin.eta]
   321	      ring
   322	    have hl : b (lastIndex k hk) + perturbation b e (lastIndex k hk) =
   323	        b (lastIndex k hk) * lastCoefficient e := by
   324	      simp only [perturbation, lastIndex, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceDIte]
   325	      ring
   326	    have hsum : (∑ i : Fin (k - 1),
   327	        a (prefixIndex i) * (b (prefixIndex i) + perturbation b e (prefixIndex i))) =
   328	        sequentialInnerProduct a b e := by
   329	      rw [innerProduct_expansion]
   330	      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
   331	      intro i hi
   332	      rw [hp]
   333	      ring
   334	    rw [hsum, hl]
   335	    have hlast : computedUpdate hk a b c e *
   336	        (b (lastIndex k hk) * lastCoefficient e) = c - sequentialInnerProduct a b e := by
   337	      unfold computedUpdate roundedNumerator lastCoefficient
   338	      field_simp [hb, ne_of_gt hsub, ne_of_gt hdiv]
   339	    rw [hlast]
   340	    ring
   341	  · intro i
   342	    unfold perturbation
   343	    split_ifs with hi
   344	    · rw [abs_mul]
   345	      have h := innerCoefficient_bound hk e u hu hu1 hku he ⟨i.val, hi⟩
   346	      calc
   347	        |b i| * |innerCoefficient e ⟨i.val, hi⟩ - 1| ≤ |b i| * gamma k u :=

   349	        _ = gamma k u * |b i| := mul_comm _ _

   352	      calc
